Minimum 1 year of related experience or training.

Reporting to the DGSOM Building Operations Manager, the Building Coordinator serves as the primary coordinator for CHS building operations, access control. Serves as backup coverage for building coordinators and delivers cross-building operational assistance as needed. Oversees CHS loading dock B, and the conference rooms at CHS, conducting regular facility inspections, coordinating maintenance follow-up, tracking projects, and reviewing access and security needs. Ensures continuity of operations by assuming oversight responsibilities for assigned facilities and programs during staff absences and vacation coverage. The Building Coordinator supports distribution of building management services to occupants of DGSOM buildings as provided by other organizations or as outlined in Sales & Services agreements. Works on special projects to support changes in Building Management Operations. Works with the team closely connected to School leadership and committed to the mission, vision, and values of the DGSOM.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Demonstrated excellence in teamwork for internal and external stakeholders
Good Judgement on issues that may affect public safety
Keep up to date on all online and in person training requirements
Strong verbal communication skills. Spanish language skills
Ability to professionally interact with internal and external stakeholders
Knowledgeable in DGSOM, Facility Management (FM), and Building Operations procedures and processes, Service request system and outside venders.
Working Knowledge of UCLA and DGSOM financial systems and practices including DGSOM procurement portal, bruin buy, FM Billing with blanket and FAU, Facilities Services request (FSR) system.
Ability to follow through with tasks despite frequent interruptions
Ability to be flexible in work location and to provide consistent support to team and building occupants
